dishes.name: Göttinger Feldkieker
dishes.desc: Coarse air-dried mettwurst of pork, with protected origin. Göttingen's best-known sausage.

dishes.name: Eichsfelder Stracke
dishes.desc: Straight air-dried sausage of the Eichsfeld, slow-matured for months and sliced thin.

dishes.name: Eichsfelder Kälberblase
dishes.desc: Raw sausage stuffed into a calf bladder and matured for months. Eaten on bread with pickled cucumbers.

dishes.name: Eichsfelder Schmandkuchen
dishes.desc: Flat cake with a sour cream and custard topping, baked in the Eichsfeld.
